 'D Awards 2027 in Paris' adds to its lineup.
 SVO - WayV, EVAN, and A2O LITE are among the fourth artists performing at 'D AWARDS 2027 in PARIS'.
 Báo Tiền Phong • 28/10/2026 Follow Vietnam.vn on G o o g l e Add Vietnam.vn on G o o g l e 0 On October 28th, the D Awards organizers announced the fourth lineup of performing artists for the event, including WayV, EVAN, and A2O LITE. This marks the third time the D Awards have been held. The event will take place over two days, January 15th and 16th, 2027 (local time), at the Plenitude Arena (formerly Paris La Défense Arena), the largest indoor arena in the European Union (EU). It will also be the first awards ceremony for Korean entertainment (K-content) to be held in the region. 
 Since their debut in 2019, WayV has established a strong position in the global music market, extending beyond Asia. With their sophisticated musical style and polished performances, the group has created a unique identity. This past August, WayV released their eighth mini-album, 'Vision Wings,' showcasing an expansion in their musical range. You may also like The participation of solo artist EVAN also attracted much attention. After starting his solo career in June with his debut single 'Ride or Die', EVAN continued to release his first mini-album 'DEATH OF ME' in September. In his solo works, he directly participates in the lyric writing, songwriting, and visual direction process, thereby building a unique musical identity. A2O LITE, a K-pop group that debuted in the latter half of this year, will also be performing. Upon their debut this month, their first song, "NEON," quickly swept major music charts and music shows in Korea and internationally, creating a viral challenge trend on social media globally. You may also like Previously, D AWARDS announced the list of performing artists in three phases. Jihyo (TWICE) will serve as the main host and performer, along with TXT, Yeonjun, DPR IAN, P1Harmony, YENA, KISS OF LIFE, AMPERS&ONE, RESCENE, KickFlip, KiiiKiii, IDID, ALPHA DRIVE ONE, LNGSHOT, and AND2BLE.
 The fifth lineup of artists, the detailed schedule for the two-day event, and official information regarding ticket sales will be announced soon.
